answer:
The fuses are located on the power board within the electric panel of the machine. 

To replace the fuses, follow these steps:
1) Unplug the machine.
2) Open the electric panel by releasing the lateral hooks.
3) Remove each fuse from the power board and individually check their continuity until the faulty one is found. Remove only one fuse at a time; once checked, if the fuse is not faulty, put it back in place before removing the next one.
4) Replace it with a new fuse having the same electrical characteristics and dimensions.
5) Check that the fuse caps have been correctly put back on [top_ex.pdf page 39]. 

If you need more specific locations or details about particular fuses, please clarify your question.
